section.p: You can call this method to play a specified sound effect to all users in the channel. Each call to this method can only play one sound effect. To play multiple sound effects simultaneously, use different soundId and filePath and call this method multiple times. This method allows you to set whether to publish the sound effect in the channel.

You can call this method to play a specified sound effect to all users in the channel. Each call to this method can only play one sound effect. To play multiple sound effect files simultaneously, call this method multiple times with different soundId and filePath values and set the playback parameters separately.

ul.li: Agora recommends not playing more than three sound effects simultaneously.
The sound effect ID and file path in this method must be consistent with those in the method.
If is called before , the file resource will not be closed after is executed, and the next call to will start playing from the beginning.
If is not called before , the resource will be destroyed after is executed, and the next call to will attempt to reopen the file and start playing from the beginning.
Agora recommends not playing more than three sound effects at the same time.
The soundId and filePath in this method must be the same as those in the preloadEffectEx method.
If you call preloadEffectEx before playEffectEx, the file resource will not be released after playEffectEx is executed. The next call to playEffectEx will start playback from the beginning.

If you do not call preloadEffectEx before playEffectEx, the resource will be released after playEffectEx is executed. The next call to playEffectEx will attempt to reopen the file and start playback from the beginning.

section.p: You can call this method to play a specified sound effect to all users in the channel. Each call to this method can only play one sound effect. To play multiple sound effects simultaneously, please call this method multiple times. This method allows you to set whether to publish sound effects in a channel. In order to play multiple sound files simultaneously, simply call the method multiple times with different soundId and filePath parameters.

ul.li: Agora recommends not playing more than three sound effects at the same time.
The sound effect ID and file path in this method must be consistent with those in the method.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: This method is applicable to multi-channel scenarios.
